metric: Indicative reference rate for US dollars, units of BDT per 1 USD
caveat: Bangladesh Bank publishes this USD/BDT figure as an indicative reference rate for information; it is not a transaction rate and should not be used to price a specific transfer. The European Central Bank table used for the currency-to-USD leg is likewise for information only. A BDT figure built from these legs is therefore an estimate of scale, labelled as such.
source_method: Retrieved 2026-10-12 from the Bangladesh Bank website reference rate for 11 October 2026. The ECB reference set does not publish a EUR/BDT rate, so BDT is stored in its own artefact and later dated than the ECB table it composes with.
